summary: The diff implements both REQ-16 (backend unification) and REQ-17 (frontend merging) reasonably well. The backend now stores all questions in a single Map and all query functions draw from it. The frontend uses a new useAllQuestions hook that merges backend questions with static questions in TopicBrowserScreen and HomeScreen. However, there are gaps: the backend does not seed previously hardcoded questions (the Map starts empty), and there is no backend random quiz set function.

missing_requirements.requirement: Previously hardcoded questions continue to appear in all filters as before.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend uses a Map that starts empty (Map.empty). There is no seeding of previously hardcoded questions into this map. The getQuestions, getByTopic, and getByYear functions will return empty results until questions are added via addQuestion, so the AC requiring hardcoded questions to continue appearing in backend filters is not met.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin-added questions are included in random quiz sets generated by the backend.
missing_requirements.reason: There is no backend function that generates random quiz sets. The random quiz logic is entirely client-side in HomeScreen.tsx and TopicBrowserScreen.tsx. The AC explicitly mentions random quiz sets generated by the backend.

hallucinated_features.description: A migration.mo module with a run function to migrate old actor state from array-based questions to Map-based questions, applied during upgrades.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention any data migration requirement. This module was not requested and adds unrequested complexity.

hallucinated_features.description: ID offset of +100000 applied to backend questions when converting to local format to avoid ID collisions with static questions.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention any ID collision handling strategy. This is an undocumented implementation decision not requested in the spec.

hallucinated_features.description: Deduplication of backend questions against static questions by matching question text.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention deduplication logic. The requirements only ask for merging backend and static questions, not deduplicating them by text.
